annotations.title: Archive, mark read, react or accept in the inbox

description: Act on one direct-message conversation (channel + conversationId from search_inbox or list_inbox’s `conversation`). archive / unarchive / delete: Hermoso’s own record only — nothing changes on the platform and the person sees nothing; list_inbox and the Inbox hide archived and removed conversations, and a new message from the person brings one back. mark_read (the person sees it as seen / blue ticks) and typing ("typing…"): Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp. accept (Messenger / Instagram message requests): Meta has no accept call, a reply accepts it, so pass `text`, the reply to send — show the user the wording first. react / unreact with `emoji` on the person’s newest message (or `messageId`): Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp (WhatsApp: a message up to 30 days old). delete_message: X only, an X DM the brand sent (`messageId`; confirm-gated; billed like every X call). Editing or deleting a sent Messenger, Instagram or WhatsApp message is refused by name: Meta offers no such call. Slack, Telegram, Discord and iMessage have their own edit / delete / react tools and the answer names them. Free except X.

channel.description: whatsapp, meta (Messenger / Instagram), x, telegram, sms, imessage, line, slack, discord, email, domain_mail or call

confirm.description: delete_message: true only after the user agreed

conversationId.description: the conversation id from search_inbox, or the `conversation.conversationId` on a list_inbox item

emoji.description: react: the emoji to react with, e.g. a thumbs-up or a heart

id.description: alternatively a list_inbox composite id of a DM, e.g. "whatsapp:123|15551234567"

messageId.description: react / unreact / delete_message: which message (default: the person’s newest)

text.description: accept: the reply that accepts the message request
